labels.description: Notify about labels applied to or removed from the account or its content.

account.description: Notify about moderation actions against the account or its content, excluding labeling.

reports.description: Notify about outcomes of reports filed by the account.

main.description: Update the authenticated account's moderation push notification preferences. Only provided categories are updated; omitted categories retain their values. At least one category must be provided. Returns all three preferences. These preferences do not hide in-app inbox activity.
